text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“—Whyyyy!? Even though I drank it...
the throbbing's getting WORSEーー!?”

and blending it up to make Tsuyoshi's special—"

text_block_list.text: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi ended up suffering from a lingering headache.
